tools.name: search_schools
tools.description: Search Hungarian driving schools (autósiskolák) ranked by JogsiMérleg index (0–10, 5 = national average), using official KAV exam pass rates (VSM) and lesson hours (ÁKÓ). Filter by city (e.g. "Debrecen"), Budapest district number, licence category (B, A, AM, C) and minimum score.

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: Full official data for one driving school by its KAV id (képzőszervi azonosító): address, categories, quarterly VSM/ÁKÓ vs national average, index, ranks, sources.

tools.name: compare_schools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 driving schools by id.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Hungarian towns with driving schools, school counts and average practical exam pass rate.

tools.name: request_offers
tools.description: Send the user's enquiry to 1–3 driving schools so they contact the user with an offer. ONLY call this when the user has explicitly asked for it and agreed that their name and contact details are shared with the selected schools; set userConsent=true only in that case.
